summary: fal offers MiniMax H3 Max in its browser sandbox with five free videos per day, up to 15 seconds each with native audio. Both text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) are supported; fal advertises a 5-second video generated in under 3 seconds and identifies the leaderboard model as 768p. A fal account and sign-in are required; no installation or subscription is needed. The allowance resets every 24 hours. Announced by fal's Blendi (@blendibyl) on X.
claim_steps: Open https://fal.ai/minimax-h3-max and create a fal account or sign in.
Describe the shot, camera move and sound, or attach an image for image-to-video.
Generate up to five free clips per day, up to 15 seconds each with synchronized audio.
The free allowance resets every 24 hours; no subscription or installation is required.
